title: Rejoice, Ye Sons of Men Alway
description: Rejoice, Ye Sons of Men Alway in Tonic Solfa to MELCOMBE, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: Cornelius Freund wrote these words in German. August Crull's translation was printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 151.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to MELCOMBE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Re-joice, ye sons of men al-way! God comes to you from heaven to day; The Lord is born a lit-tle child Of Ma-ry, cho-sen vir-gin mild.

lines: Rejoice, ye sons of men alway!
God comes to you from heaven to-day;
The Lord is born a little child
He is the Branch of Jesse’s tree,
The Lion out of Judah He,
The Gentiles’ Light, the promised Seed
Who was to bruise the Serpent’s head.
He brings us peace and happiness
And heals all sorrow and distress
Which on account of Adam’s fall
Through His low birth and holy blood
We all are saved by Christ, true God;
The angels’ glory we shall share
And in His kingdom live fore’er.

licence: Public domain: Cornelius Freund died in 1591; August Crull died in 1923.
credits: Words by Cornelius Freund (1535–1591), translated by August Crull (1845–1923), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to MELCOMBE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
